name: Pressure Gun
status: Integrated in Prototype 26; packaged headless checks pass; live balance playtest pending
attack_timing: Interval is start-to-start and includes windup and recovery; damage occurs once per target per attack.

projectile.distance_measure: Cumulative path length from muzzle; expire at limit
projectile.on_enemy_or_solid_collision: apply damage to enemy if present, then despawn

art.brief: Compact brass-and-teal water gun with pressure gauge; crisp blue water bolts.

range_design.measurement: Logical world pixels traveled from muzzle; independent of window size and camera scrolling
range_design.intent: Short ranged: beyond all current Tony melee reaches, less than half screen

aiming.status: Implemented in Prototype 28; headless checks pass. Directional hero presentation pending modular art; current hero pose remains horizontal.
aiming.no_direction_input: Fire horizontally in current facing direction
aiming.down_fire: Down-left and down-right allowed grounded or airborne; straight down only while airborne.
aiming.grounded_down_input: Down plus left/right aims diagonally down on ground; only straight down requires airborne state. Down alone on ground falls back to horizontal facing.
aiming.vector_rule: Normalize diagonal direction so projectile speed and cumulative travel range match cardinal shots
aiming.range_rule: Keep existing max_travel_distance_pixels in every direction
aiming.input_note: Preserve keyboard and controller support. Resolve existing up-to-jump binding conflict so aiming up does not unintentionally jump.
aiming.art_note: Directional held-weapon/hero poses require Bestiary / Art collaboration before new artwork is created

visual_aim.rule: Continuously display current valid aim direction while aiming, whether idle, moving, airborne, firing or between shots.
visual_aim.release_fire: Keep the aimed pose while directional input remains held; never reset orientation merely because firing/recoil animation ends.
visual_aim.release_aim: Use existing no_direction_input horizontal-facing fallback when directional input is released; no new aim-lock behavior.
visual_aim.alignment: Held weapon, arm pose and projectile muzzle direction must share current aim; firing adds recoil/flash without controlling aim orientation.
visual_aim.restrictions: Only straight-down aim is airborne-only. Landing preserves downward diagonal aim; grounded straight-down falls back horizontally.

aiming.movement_animation_requirement: Use locomotion animation independently of held aim. Every valid aim must preserve moving legs while running and appropriate takeoff/rise/apex/fall/landing poses while jumping.
aiming.direction_revision_status: Grounded downward diagonals and locomotion audit approved; Engineering integration pending

active_level_profile.note: Default first-level playtest uses this faster balance; top-level values retain the original baseline for comparison.
